title: Implement a channel-based semaphore in Go
description: Implement Semaphore with Acquire() and Release() using a buffered channel. Acquire blocks when at capacity; Release unblocks a waiting Acquire.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement Semaphore in semaphore.go using a buffered channel of size n:
- `New(n)`: create `ch: make(chan struct{}, n)`
- `Acquire()`: send an empty struct into ch (blocks if full)
- `Release()`: receive from ch (frees a slot)
All 3 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
